title: Nostalgia
notes: Nearly every asset lives in MASS/*.dat archives ('SSAM': count, then offset/size/32-byte name entries from the end of the table), mostly LZ10. Maps (*.mmc) decompress to an offset table of parts, some nested, each part an 'NMDP' wrapper around a standard BMD0 or BTX0. nitro.files() unpacks all three; without them the ROM shows 1 texture.
About 171k of the BG tile keys are the painted world map in mass_navi_map.dat, which has almost no repeated tiles.

BG screens are 8bpp with palettes loaded into shared palette memory next to other colours, so the exact bg1 key (whole 256-colour palette) missed on 196/200 logged tiles whose tile hash was right. build stores tiles that occur in one image only under the '$' palette wildcard (193k of 231k files).

Compressed names keep their type ('ci_01_d.NSCR.lz'); split_name strips both extensions so the painted intro screens pair with ci_d/ci_u by name instead of tying (each page was extracted twice, once in the wrong colours).

verified.on_device: AYN Thor: painted intro BG tiles 91080/92160 lookups hit, title and main menu 92160/92160, title sprites 240/240. Towns, dungeons, battles not played yet.
